_comment: Central status catalog for KabuK Exchange. Stable keys; edit labels/definitions here only. Product-to-status mapping lives in data/product-roadmap.json. Non-English labels are draft translations pending native review.

live.use: Only for capabilities verified as generally available to partners today.
live.avoid: Never for anything still in pilot, beta or planning.

label.ja: パートナー向け提供中

available-to-partners.definition: Available to qualifying partners, with eligibility noted.
available-to-partners.use: When a capability is in production but limited to qualifying partners; state the eligibility nearby.
available-to-partners.avoid: Don't use it to soften a pilot or beta.

pilot.definition: Limited, controlled rollout with participating partners.
pilot.use: Real usage by a small, named group of partners under agreement.

beta.use: Usable before general availability; expectations and support may differ.
beta.avoid: Don't use for concepts without a usable release.

in-development.use: Only when build work is actually in progress.
in-development.avoid: Don't use for approved-but-unstarted ideas (use Planned).

integration-in-progress.definition: A specific integration is being implemented.
integration-in-progress.use: For a named integration with active implementation work.
integration-in-progress.avoid: Don't use for integrations still under discussion.

coming-soon.definition: Near-term availability supported by credible launch readiness.
coming-soon.use: Only when launch readiness is substantiated (owner sign-off).
coming-soon.avoid: Never as a generic synonym for Planned.

planned.definition: Approved future direction, not yet actively in development.
planned.use: Only after owner approval of the direction.
planned.avoid: Don't imply a date or commitment to deliver.

exploring.use: When an idea is being evaluated and nothing is committed.
exploring.avoid: Don't pair with dates or delivery language.

temporarily-unavailable.use: During a known disruption to a previously available capability.
temporarily-unavailable.avoid: Don't leave in place after recovery.

deprecated.definition: Still present but being phased out.
deprecated.use: When partners should migrate away; link to the replacement.
deprecated.avoid: Don't remove the item before partners are informed.

retired.avoid: Don't show retired items in marketing sections.
